trigger: While preparing to build the real HistoricalEvent registry, found 5 universe-PASS candidates still carrying only a date-level first_public_date rather than the exact tz-aware timestamp HistoricalEvent.event_at requires. Resolved 3 of the 5 via each issuer's own same-day SEC 8-K acceptance timestamp (a same-day filing exists for these three, consistent with the EXACT_TO_MINUTE_SEC_ACCEPTANCE_PROXY convention used throughout this workstream). The other 2 (MLTX/P2-2023-MLTX-MIRA and AMLX/REG-2022-AMLX-RELYVRIO) were weekend/evening press releases whose own text gives no HH:MM, and whose 8-K was filed the following business day (a different calendar date) - using that later filing's timestamp would misdate the event, and no genuine minute-level evidence for the actual release exists, so those two remain unresolved and are excluded from real registry inclusion rather than assigned a fabricated time.
